title: Rectangular pixel selection
summary: Select a rectangle, adjust its handles, and copy, cut or clear the selected pixels with Undo.

Added: Selection now supports reverse dragging, bounded movement and eight resize handles, plus Select entire image and Deselect.
Copy selection preserves exact color and transparency. Ctrl+C, Ctrl+X and Delete operate on the pixel selection; Copy All still copies the complete image.
Cut and Clear show a flattening review for editable objects. Cut copies successfully before clearing; one Undo restores pixels and objects.
Verified: Native reverse selection, movement, resizing, Copy/Cut, review Cancel, Undo/Redo and save passed on synthetic content.
All 129600 selected clipboard pixels and all 256000 saved image pixels match independent expected images, including transparency and unchanged pixels outside the selection.
Tests verify clipboard failure preserves editable objects, Undo/Redo history and image pixels.

limitations: This release selects rectangular pixels. Ellipse, polygon, lasso, inverse selection, Magic Wand, selection-constrained Fill and moving selected pixel content remain unfinished.
Moving the rectangle changes the selection only. Pixel edits flatten annotations after review; Undo restores them. Undo exits the transient selection mode.
This unsigned Windows alpha does not claim complete Snagit behavior or interface parity.
